story.title: Justin Timberlake Documentary Trailer: “He’s Not Who I Thought He Was”
story.summary: A "raw, reflective and revealing portrait" of Timberlake is coming to Apple TV. Logo text Justin Timberlake is the subject of a new four-part documentary series that promises to explore his personal and professional life. Apple TV just announced and released a trailer (below) for Timberlake , which is described as a “raw, reflective and revealing portrait of the life and career of multi-hyphenate artist and icon.” The series is directed by Academy Award winner Fisher Stevens (The Cove) and spans three decades of music and popular culture, and features never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive interviews with Timberlake and his family, friends and collaborators. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' )…
